components.name: FFmpeg
components.note: ffmpeg and ffprobe are separate programs beside the sidecar, started as child processes and never linked into Panelyth. They are an unmodified LGPL version 3 build (no GPL or non-free parts). The build, its source and its configuration, which names every library linked into it, are in bin/FFMPEG-BUILD.txt in the application's resources. You may replace them with another build of the same version.
